import { commandBackendWudao } from '@src/api/bot/skill-book-wudao';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { executeWudao, prepareWudao } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/wudao/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import type { GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 构建悟道属性选择按钮（用于提示阶段）。
 */
const buildAttrButtons = (userSkillBookId: number, labels: string[]): GuiButton[][] => {
  const rows: GuiButton[][] = [];
  const perRow = 3;

  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i += perRow) {
    const slice = labels.slice(i, i + perRow);

    rows.push(slice.map(label => ({ label, command: `/悟道 ${userSkillBookId} ${label}` })));
  }

  return rows;
};

/**
 * /悟道 {已学功法id} [属性]
 * - 消耗 1 个【悟道石】
 * - 不提供属性时展示可选属性，并通过按钮 /悟道 {id} {属性} 一次性触发
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const rawText = String(e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const normalized = rawText.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?/, '').trim();

  if (!normalized.startsWith('悟道')) {
    return;
  }

  const rest = normalized.replace(/^悟道\s*/, '').trim();
  const parts = rest ? rest.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = parts[0] ?? '';
  const chosenLabel = parts.slice(1).join(' ').trim();

  if (!skillBookIdStr) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('❤ 参数错误\n\n使用方法:\n/悟道 已学功法ID 属性\n\n示例:\n/悟道 123');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const userSkillBookId = parseInt(skillBookIdStr, 10);

  if (!Number.isFinite(userSkillBookId) || userSkillBookId <= 0) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('参数错误：已学功法ID必须为正整数。\n\n用法：/悟道 123');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  let command: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof commandBackendWudao>> | undefined;
  let commandError: unknown;

  if (chosenLabel) {
    try {
      command = await commandBackendWudao(bid, uid, userSkillBookId, chosenLabel, createBackendRequestContext(e));
    } catch (error) {
      commandError = error;
    }
  }
  const prepareResult = commandError
    ? { code: 'LOAD_FAILED' as const, data: { message: commandError instanceof Error ? commandError.message : '悟道准备失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。' } }
    : await prepareWudao({ bid, uid, userSkillBookId, prepared: command?.options });

  if (prepareResult.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(prepareResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (prepareResult.code === 'NO_STONE') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('悟道');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(prepareResult.data.message);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡需要至少 1 个悟道石才能悟道。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (prepareResult.code === 'NO_RECORD') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('悟道');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(prepareResult.data.message);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡功法ID来自 /我的功法 列表前的数字。');
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }] }));

    return;
  }

  if (prepareResult.code === 'NO_ATTRS') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('悟道');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(prepareResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (prepareResult.code !== 'OK') {
    return;
  }

  const { skillBookName, ownedQty, available } = prepareResult.data;
  const labels = available.map(x => x.label);
  const labelToAttr: Map<string, (typeof available)[number]> = new Map(available.map(x => [x.label, x]));

  // 未选择属性 → 展示提示 + 属性按钮
  if (!chosenLabel) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('悟道');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`目标功法：【${skillBookName}】`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`将消耗：悟道石 x1（当前拥有：${ownedQty}）`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`请发送：/悟道 ${userSkillBookId} 属性名`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('可选"上限属性"：');
    md.addNewline();

    available.forEach(cfg => {
      const suffix = cfg.isPercent ? '%' : '';

      md.addText(`• ${cfg.label}：${cfg.currentMaxText}${suffix} / ${cfg.templateMaxText}${suffix}`);
      md.addNewline();
    });

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: buildAttrButtons(userSkillBookId, labels) }));

    return;
  }

  const selectedAttr = labelToAttr.get(chosenLabel);

  if (!selectedAttr) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`未知属性：${chosenLabel}；可选：${labels.join(' / ')}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: buildAttrButtons(userSkillBookId, labels) }));

    return;
  }

  const execResult = await executeWudao({
    bid,
    uid,
    userSkillBookId,
    attrKey: selectedAttr.attr,
    prepared: command?.result ?? undefined,
    failure: command ? command.failure || (command.result ? '' : '悟道结算响应不完整') : undefined,
    request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
  });

  if (execResult.code !== 'OK') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(execResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: buildAttrButtons(userSkillBookId, labels) }));

    return;
  }

  const { data } = execResult;
  const suffix = data.isPercent ? '%' : '';
  const growthText = data.growthText;
  const newMaxText = data.newMaxText;
  const templateMaxText = data.templateMaxText;

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addBold('悟道成功');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`功法：【${data.skillBookName}】`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`属性：${data.label}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`上限提升：+${growthText}${suffix}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`当前上限：${newMaxText}${suffix} / ${templateMaxText}${suffix}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`剩余悟道石：${data.remaining}`);
  md.addNewline();

  const successFooter = [
    { label: '继续悟道', command: `/悟道 ${userSkillBookId}` },
    { label: '查看功法', command: `/查看功法 ${userSkillBookId}` }
  ];

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: successFooter }));
});
